item.rswirelesscrafting.wireless_craftin: Access and craft on your network from anywhere
Sneak + right-click to open the upgrade bay; cards can be swapped anytime
item.rswirelesscrafting.upgrade.install_: Slots into the Wireless Crafting Grid (sneak + right-click it)
Increases the grid's battery capacity for longer trips
item.rswirelesscrafting.range_upgrade.de: Ignores distance within the same dimension
item.rswirelesscrafting.interdimensional: Requires a bound Network Receiver, with both chunks loaded
item.rswirelesscrafting.remote_energy_up: Draws energy from the bound network, so the grid never needs charging
Requires a bound network with stored energy
block.rswirelesscrafting.charging_statio: Draws energy from the network to charge the slot and nearby players
External FE buffer: other mods' energy blocks can feed this

text.autoconfig.rswirelesscrafting.optio: Wireless Crafting Grid
Configuration for the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Energy capacity
The energy capacity of the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Battery Upgrade capacity
Extra energy capacity granted by a single Battery Upgrade.
Open energy usage
The energy usage of opening the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Crafting energy usage
The energy usage of crafting an item in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Autocrafting energy usage
The energy usage of autocrafting a resource with the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Clear matrix energy usage
The energy usage of clearing the crafting matrix in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Recipe transfer energy usage
The energy usage of transferring a recipe in the Wireless Crafting Grid.
Interdimensional energy multiplier
Energy multiplier (in percent) applied when the grid is used across dimensions.
Extended range
Minimum effective range (in blocks) of the wireless crafting grid in the same dimension.
400V Air-Cooled Charging Station
Configuration for the 400V Air-Cooled Charging Station.
Idle energy usage
Idle energy usage of this Charging Station on the network.
Wired charge rate
Energy per tick transferred to the item in the wired slot.
Wireless charge rate
Energy per tick transferred to nearby players' items.
Wireless radius
Radius (in blocks) of the wireless charging area.
External FE buffer capacity
Internal FE buffer, fed by other mods' energy blocks when the network is empty.
